name: proto-facts-leave-report-unchanged
description: Asking for facts leaves the report and the exit code byte-identical in every language, beside a generated file of a row that binds and one whose declarations bind nothing: a protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.0.1 file, which states no version, in Go, and a protoc-gen-es v0.5.0 file of the unsupported row in TypeScript. Neither publishes a consumer record of its declarations.
